answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, clawed back after a replayed submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. What survives to the sparrow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The onyx holds work receipts rather than names, so the ivory of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
